note: Daily snapshots of the CIO research-panel directional calls (from data/model.json), used to score the model against what actually happened. The dashboard computes realized returns from its own price history: for each snapshot ≥5 trading days old, predicted direction (pUp3m vs 50%) is compared with the realized move since the call date. Backfilled from git history 2026-06-08 onward; the scheduled agent appends one snapshot per day (keep ≤120).
